text_blocks.snippet: The Charmander - 044 (Scarlet & Violet Promo) is a popular Black Star Promo from the Obsidian Flames era.

list.snippet: Card Number / Set: 044 (SV Black Star Promos)
HP & Type: 60 HP, Fire Stage: Basic
Attack: Heat Tackle [R] (Does 30 damage, and 10 damage to itself)
Origin: Originally came bundled with Pokémon Center Elite Trainer Boxes (ETBs) for Obsidian Flames, featuring both regular and Pokémon Center-stamped variations.
Ungraded / Raw: Typically trades around $49.11 on platforms like Cardmarket or roughly $53 according to PriceCharting.
Graded (PSA 10 / CGC 10): Higher-tier graded copies range from roughly $165 to $560+ depending on the grading company and whether it carries the exclusive Pokémon Center stamp.
